ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( ISBLANK(TEXT( Account.Region__c )), ISBLANK( Account.Website ) ) && AND( RecordType.Name = 'Partner', ISCHANGED( StageName ), ISPICKVAL( StageName,"Contacted") )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please ensure the following fields are populated on the Account to be able to move the stage to Contacted: [Region], [Website]
